article.title: Meet Earth's newest wild cat species, the first named in over a century

article.title: NASA-Funded Research Finds Complex Life Defying Record Heat
article.keyword: Incendiamoeba cascadensis reproduces at 63 degrees Celsius
article.summary: NASA-funded researchers report that Incendiamoeba cascadensis reproduces by division at 63 degrees Celsius, remains active and mobile up to 64 degrees, and is only partially active at 66 degrees in lab tests. It can recover after five minutes at 70 degrees, while 80 degrees is too hot for recovery. The finding sets a record upper reproduction temperature for eukaryotes and challenges assumptions about complex-cell stability.

End with the brief five-minute 70-degree recovery test and the 80-degree limit. Do not call 66 degrees the growth or reproduction limit.

article.title: After Latest Swing Past Sun, NASA's Parker Solar Probe Checks in
article.keyword: Parker Solar Probe ninth day communication beacon September 2026
article.summary: Parker Solar Probe completed its 29th close approach to the Sun on September 4, passing within 3.8 million miles and collecting data from the corona. Detailed telemetry was scheduled to begin September 11, with science data transmission planned for September 13-27.
